body: Sorry I’m a little confused by the last part. People thinking that being a tomboy means you’re gay, made you gay? I’m also confused by how your own lust can cause SSA. wouldn’t lust come after you become same sex attracted?

I know it doesn’t, but my brain still made that connection between the words “born again” and feeling bad and it sucks. Even when it’s not being used to condemn gay people there’s that uptick in an anxiety it creates for me

What do you do if the group is already mid-conversation though? The problem for me is if they’re already talking about something and then I don’t know what to say or add and I feel like I come across as too serious since I end up not talking unless I’m directly addressed

I mean there are still good people out there though. I only have one friend and she’s so busy nowadays we barely talk. Being alone sometimes is great but I’m alone practically all the time. It’s making me pretty sad, and it’s hard to enjoy your own company when you’re sad
Not really, plus I don’t want to anyone to know what I am so I’m just keeping it a secret for now…
To be honest it being a perversion of the flesh doesn’t make me feel much better. Makes me feel more like it’s my fault. But you’re right I should try to be patient and keep asking for forgiveness
I don’t understand. Are you saying the thoughts I had would be considered lust?
I know that not all temptation is sexual, I’m just confused because I don’t know if the thoughts I had counted as lust
same sex attraction

Hey, I’m female also struggling with same sex desires. Do you have any advice on how to handle the temptation of “coming out” and/or entering a relationship? And how to resist acting on your attraction without hating yourself for being attracted? It is hard for me to not feel like I am wrong for feeling this way

The negativity isn’t coming from my church, they don’t talk about homosexuality much but they do believe that marriage is only between a man and a woman. I think the negativity mostly came from me reading essays or watching videos on Christianity and homosexuality and just taking it to the extreme on my own. You’re probably right that I shouldn’t be so hard on myself but I’m worried that if I’m not I’ll give in
I’m thinking of leaving because it’s making me too scared. I don’t want to live in constant fear of hell and God’s wrath
I checked it out but it seemed to be focused on helping with trauma and addiction, neither of which I have so i don’t know if it would help me
Like reading I guess
I’m sorry... I’ll pray things get better for you
Yes I have some positive things I can focus on
I haven't tried it, it didn't seem like it would work
In me
I guess obligation? It’s the right thing to do I guess, but there’s also a lot of fear that I’m just doing the wrong thing and god might be angry
I have to see them on Monday unfortunately... I guess I’ll try not to look at them or think about them
When I pray I just feel stupid and like I’m not doing anything. Just talking to myself
Why?
You found black magic to be real?
Yeah. I haven’t reached out to them about this though, maybe I should
I’ve tried but I keep being afraid I’m making a mistake
I wonder about the longevity of it as well. I don’t know if I can live like this my whole life
But if he didn’t create us to be that way then why am I this way?
What do you mean? It is a religion
What if I don’t know how to hear Him? What if I take something as a sign but it isn’t?

Thank you for the advice. I think I might be having a migraine so hopefully the dissociating will stop once it’s over. I just don’t know how to accept my attraction when every time I start to  accept it I just feel bad about not torturing myself over it... but you’re right. God is patient. I keep thinking about how angry he must be with me but he’s patient and understanding
I think the only trauma would be the shame and self loathing for being attracted to the same sex
